title: Asiad: Olympian Aira Villegas loses to India’s Chaudhary, suffers early exit
summary: Olympic bronze medalist boxer Aira Villegas suffered an early exit in the 20th Asian Games, an unfortunate repeat of her fate in the previous continental showcase.
